scripts.types: jco guest-types ../contracts/c4-pipeline/wit --world-name c4-engine -o generated/engine && jco guest-types ../contracts/c4-pipeline/wit --world-name c4-compiler-core -o generated/compiler && jco guest-types ../contracts/c4-pipeline/wit --world-name excalidraw-policy-component -o generated/policy
